subject: [PATCH 38/60] mm/page_alloc: refuse contiguous allocation from private memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memory management in the Linux kernel by introducing a new mechanism to refuse contiguous allocation from private memory nodes. The goal is to prevent potential issues that can arise when allocating large contiguous blocks of memory on private nodes, which bypasses the zonelists and can trigger compaction and reclaim.
